solution_summary: One NZ used Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, KQL Database to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Amazon Connect, Kinesis data streams, Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Empowered teams can now make accurate, data-driven decisions and respond to customer inquiries nearly twice as fast as before.
